mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_reading_event (event_id, user_id, post_id, session_id, event_type, active_seconds_delta, max_scroll_depth, occurred_at, received_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{postId}, #{sessionId}, #{eventType}, #{activeSecondsDelta}, #{maxScrollDepth}, #{occurredAt}, #{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id = event_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM post_reading_event WHERE projected_at IS NULL ORDER BY received_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE post_reading_event SET projected_at = #{projectedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND projected_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_reading_event WHERE projected_at IS NOT NULL AND received_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_post_reading_history (user_id, post_id, read_count, total_active_seconds, first_read_at, last_read_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'READ_OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{activeSecondsDelta}, #{receivedAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_count = read_count + CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'READ_OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, total_active_seconds = total_active_seconds + #{activeSecondsDelta}, first_read_at = LEAST(first_read_at, #{receivedAt}), last_read_at = GREATEST(last_read_at, #{receivedAt}), updated_at = #{receivedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT h.* FROM user_post_reading_history h JOIN post p ON p.id = h.post_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.post_id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
